lines.text: A food-ordering platform cut its server bill by up to sixty-four percent.
Before, every brand got its own cluster with 21 services. Five brands meant 105 services.
lines.title: Before and after

lines.text: A shared code library tags each request with a brand ID and sends it only to that brand's data.
lines.title: Keeping brands apart

lines.text: Warm pools keep prepared servers stopped and ready, so extra capacity can start fast.
lines.title: Warm pool

lines.text: New capacity now arrives in thirty to sixty seconds, instead of five to seven minutes.
lines.title: Scaling time

lines.text: Compute cost fell by forty-seven to sixty-four percent, depending on the savings plan.
lines.title: Cost savings

lines.text: Sharing saves money, but isolation between customers must be built carefully in code.
lines.title: Takeaways
